title: ConDÉ — faire vivre six siècles de coutumiers normands (Corpus Numérique des Éditions de la Coutume de Normandie)
notes: The ConDE project (RIN = Réseau d'Intérêt Normand funding scheme; the TEI corpus itself is released on GitHub at github.com/RIN-ConDE/editions, which is why the RQ collection carries the 'RIN-ConDE' name) transcribes and TEI-encodes successive editions of the Coutume de Normandie and its commentaries (Le Rouillé 1539, Terrien 1578, Bérault 1614, Basnage 1678...). The project site is hosted by the MRSH / Pôle Document Numérique in Caen with a blog at conde.hypotheses.org; corpus cited as 'corpus ConDE, Caen, CRISCO EA4255'. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: CRISCO EA4255 / MRSH, Université de Caen Normandie (Pierre Larrivée, Mathieu Goux; with Université de Rouen), funded by the Région Normandie RIN programme
